verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships a real-time monitoring dashboard with live system metrics and browser-pool visibility, which covers basic job/performance monitoring. Its `on_state_change` callbacks and automatic retries offer hooks a user could wire into failure handling. Data-quality validation and alerting are not documented, and community feedback says users must build their own quality gates. missing for 10: built-in data-quality validation, failure alerting/notifications, per-job performance metrics documentation, independent corroboration of the dashboard
